blurb: A hymn to Mahāvīra by the poet Dhanapāla, its verses interweaving Sanskrit and Prakrit pādas.

padas.deva:
सरभसनृत्यत्सुरयुवतिकुचतटत्रुटितहारतारकितम्।
जायं सिद्धत्थनरिंदमंदिरं जस्स जम्मम्मि॥१॥
[जातं सिद्धार्थनरेन्द्रमन्दिरं यस्य जन्मनि॥]
padas.iast:
sarabhasanṛtyatsurayuvatikucataṭatruṭitahāratārakitam.
jāyaṃ siddhatthanariṃdamaṃdiraṃ jassa jammammi..1..
[jātaṃ siddhārthanarendramandiraṃ yasya janmani..]
padas.iso:
sarabhasanr̥tyatsurayuvatikucataṭatruṭitahāratārakitam.
jāyaṁ siddhatthanariṁdamaṁdiraṁ jassa jammammi..1..
[jātaṁ siddhārthanarēndramandiraṁ yasya janmani..]
padas.hk:
sarabhasanRtyatsurayuvatikucataTatruTitahAratArakitam.
jAyaM siddhatthanariMdamaMdiraM jassa jammammi..1..
[jAtaM siddhArthanarendramandiraM yasya janmani..]
padas.slp1:
saraBasanftyatsurayuvatikucatawatruwitahAratArakitam.
jAyaM sidDatTanariMdamaMdiraM jassa jammammi..1..
[jAtaM sidDArTanarendramandiraM yasya janmani..]

padas.deva:
बुद्ध्वाऽवधिना निजजन्ममज्जने हृदयभावमशनिभृतः।
लीलाइ चलणकोडीइ चालिओ जेण सुरसेलो॥२॥
[लीलया चरणकोट्या चालितो येन सुरशैलः॥]
padas.iast:
buddhvā'vadhinā nijajanmamajjane hṛdayabhāvamaśanibhṛtaḥ.
līlāi calaṇakoḍīi cālio jeṇa suraselo..2..
[līlayā caraṇakoṭyā cālito yena suraśailaḥ..]
padas.iso:
buddhvā’vadhinā nijajanmamajjanē hr̥dayabhāvamaśanibhr̥taḥ.
līlāi calaṇakōḍīi cāliō jēṇa surasēlō..2..
[līlayā caraṇakōṭyā cālitō yēna suraśailaḥ..]
padas.hk:
buddhvA'vadhinA nijajanmamajjane hRdayabhAvamazanibhRtaH.
lIlAi calaNakoDIi cAlio jeNa suraselo..2..
[lIlayA caraNakoTyA cAlito yena surazailaH..]
padas.slp1:
budDvA'vaDinA nijajanmamajjane hfdayaBAvamaSaniBftaH.
lIlAi calaRakoqIi cAlio jeRa suraselo..2..
[lIlayA caraRakowyA cAlito yena suraSElaH..]

padas.deva:
येन च बाल्ये विबुधो विवर्धमानः सविभ्रमं नभसि।
हणिऊण मुट्ठिणा वामणीकओ कुलिसकढिणेणं॥३॥
[हत्वा मुष्टिना वामनीकृतः कुलिशकठिनया॥]
padas.iast:
yena ca bālye vibudho vivardhamānaḥ savibhramaṃ nabhasi.
haṇiūṇa muṭṭhiṇā vāmaṇīkao kulisakaḍhiṇeṇaṃ..3..
[hatvā muṣṭinā vāmanīkṛtaḥ kuliśakaṭhinayā..]
padas.iso:
yēna ca bālyē vibudhō vivardhamānaḥ savibhramaṁ nabhasi.
haṇiūṇa muṭṭhiṇā vāmaṇīkaō kulisakaḍhiṇēṇaṁ..3..
[hatvā muṣṭinā vāmanīkr̥taḥ kuliśakaṭhinayā..]
padas.hk:
yena ca bAlye vibudho vivardhamAnaH savibhramaM nabhasi.
haNiUNa muTThiNA vAmaNIkao kulisakaDhiNeNaM..3..
[hatvA muSTinA vAmanIkRtaH kulizakaThinayA..]
padas.slp1:
yena ca bAlye vibuDo vivarDamAnaH saviBramaM naBasi.
haRiURa muwWiRA vAmaRIkao kulisakQaiReRaM..3..
[hatvA muzwinA vAmanIkftaH kuliSakaWinayA..]

padas.deva:
सुरपतिपुरतो विवृतिं वितन्वता विततवाङ्मयं येन।
जणियं जयस्स विज्जोवएससमए महच्छरियं॥४॥
[जनितं जगतो विद्योपदेशसमये महदाश्चर्यम्॥]
padas.iast:
surapatipurato vivṛtiṃ vitanvatā vitatavāṅmayaṃ yena.
jaṇiyaṃ jayassa vijjovaesasamae mahacchariyaṃ..4..
[janitaṃ jagato vidyopadeśasamaye mahadāścaryam..]
padas.iso:
surapatipuratō vivr̥tiṁ vitanvatā vitatavāṅmayaṁ yēna.
jaṇiyaṁ jayassa vijjōvaēsasamaē mahacchariyaṁ..4..
[janitaṁ jagatō vidyōpadēśasamayē mahadāścaryam..]
padas.hk:
surapatipurato vivRtiM vitanvatA vitatavAGmayaM yena.
jaNiyaM jayassa vijjovaesasamae mahacchariyaM..4..
[janitaM jagato vidyopadezasamaye mahadAzcaryam..]
padas.slp1:
surapatipurato vivftiM vitanvatA vitatavANmayaM yena.
jaRiyaM jayassa vijjovaesasamae mahacCariyaM..4..
[janitaM jagato vidyopadeSasamaye mahadAScaryam..]

padas.deva:
मातापित्रोः प्रेमानुबन्धमधिकं विबुध्य यः स्थितवान्।
दिव्वालंकारफुरंथविग्गहो चत्तसंगो वि॥५॥
[दिव्यालङ्कारस्फुरद्विग्रहस्त्यक्तसङ्गोऽपि]
padas.iast:
mātāpitroḥ premānubandhamadhikaṃ vibudhya yaḥ sthitavān.
divvālaṃkāraphuraṃthaviggaho cattasaṃgo vi..5..
[divyālaṅkārasphuradvigrahastyaktasaṅgo'pi]
padas.iso:
mātāpitrōḥ prēmānubandhamadhikaṁ vibudhya yaḥ sthitavān.
divvālaṁkāraphuraṁthaviggahō cattasaṁgō vi..5..
[divyālaṅkārasphuradvigrahastyaktasaṅgō’pi]
padas.hk:
mAtApitroH premAnubandhamadhikaM vibudhya yaH sthitavAn.
divvAlaMkAraphuraMthaviggaho cattasaMgo vi..5..
[divyAlaGkArasphuradvigrahastyaktasaGgo'pi]
padas.slp1:
mAtApitroH premAnubanDamaDikaM vibuDya yaH sTitavAn.
divvAlaMkAraPuraMTaviggaho cattasaMgo vi..5..
[divyAlaNkArasPuradvigrahastyaktasaNgo'pi]

padas.deva:
येन परित्यज्य जरत्तृणमिव राज्यं समं सुहृत्स्वजनैः।
वूढो दढनियमभरो लीलाइ गिरिंदरुंदयरो॥६॥
[व्यूढो दृढनियमभरो लीलया गिरीन्द्रविस्तीर्णतरः॥]
padas.iast:
yena parityajya jarattṛṇamiva rājyaṃ samaṃ suhṛtsvajanaiḥ.
vūḍho daḍhaniyamabharo līlāi giriṃdaruṃdayaro..6..
[vyūḍho dṛḍhaniyamabharo līlayā girīndravistīrṇataraḥ..]
padas.iso:
yēna parityajya jarattr̥ṇamiva rājyaṁ samaṁ suhr̥tsvajanaiḥ.
vūḍhō daḍhaniyamabharō līlāi giriṁdaruṁdayarō..6..
[vyūḍhō dr̥ḍhaniyamabharō līlayā girīndravistīrṇataraḥ..]
padas.hk:
yena parityajya jarattRNamiva rAjyaM samaM suhRtsvajanaiH.
vUDho daDhaniyamabharo lIlAi giriMdaruMdayaro..6..
[vyUDho dRDhaniyamabharo lIlayA girIndravistIrNataraH..]
padas.slp1:
yena parityajya jarattfRamiva rAjyaM samaM suhftsvajanEH.
vUQo dQaaniyamaBaro lIlAi giriMdaruMdayaro..6..
[vyUQo dfQaniyamaBaro lIlayA girIndravistIrRataraH..]

padas.deva:
सङ्गमलसुरतरुण्यः स्वगात्रसौन्दर्यविजितरतिरूपाः।
अब्भत्थंतीओ दढं थेवं पि न जेण गणिआओ॥७॥
[अभ्यर्थयन्त्यो दृढं स्तोकमपि न येन गणिताः॥]
padas.iast:
saṅgamalasurataruṇyaḥ svagātrasaundaryavijitaratirūpāḥ.
abbhatthaṃtīo daḍhaṃ thevaṃ pi na jeṇa gaṇiāo..7..
[abhyarthayantyo dṛḍhaṃ stokamapi na yena gaṇitāḥ..]
padas.iso:
saṅgamalasurataruṇyaḥ svagātrasaundaryavijitaratirūpāḥ.
abbhatthaṁtīō daḍhaṁ thēvaṁ pi na jēṇa gaṇiāō..7..
[abhyarthayantyō dr̥ḍhaṁ stōkamapi na yēna gaṇitāḥ..]
padas.hk:
saGgamalasurataruNyaH svagAtrasaundaryavijitaratirUpAH.
abbhatthaMtIo daDhaM thevaM pi na jeNa gaNiAo..7..
[abhyarthayantyo dRDhaM stokamapi na yena gaNitAH..]
padas.slp1:
saNgamalasurataruRyaH svagAtrasOndaryavijitaratirUpAH.
abBatTaMtIo dQaaM TevaM pi na jeRa gaRiAo..7..
[aByarTayantyo dfQaM stokamapi na yena gaRitAH..]

padas.deva:
प्रकुपितसुराधिपविक्षिप्तादीप्तदम्भोलिभेदसम्भ्रान्तः।
चमरो चलणुप्पलमूलमागओ रक्खिओ जेण॥८॥
[चमरश्चलनोत्पलमूलमागतो रक्षितो येन॥]
padas.iast:
prakupitasurādhipavikṣiptādīptadambholibhedasambhrāntaḥ.
camaro calaṇuppalamūlamāgao rakkhio jeṇa..8..
[camaraścalanotpalamūlamāgato rakṣito yena..]
padas.iso:
prakupitasurādhipavikṣiptādīptadambhōlibhēdasambhrāntaḥ.
camarō calaṇuppalamūlamāgaō rakkhiō jēṇa..8..
[camaraścalanōtpalamūlamāgatō rakṣitō yēna..]
padas.hk:
prakupitasurAdhipavikSiptAdIptadambholibhedasambhrAntaH.
camaro calaNuppalamUlamAgao rakkhio jeNa..8..
[camarazcalanotpalamUlamAgato rakSito yena..]
padas.slp1:
prakupitasurADipavikziptAdIptadamBoliBedasamBrAntaH.
camaro calaRuppalamUlamAgao rakKio jeRa..8..
[camaraScalanotpalamUlamAgato rakzito yena..]

padas.deva:
येन घनकर्मपटलं प्रकटतपोवह्निना विनिर्दह्य।
पलयरवितेयपायडमुप्पाडियमक्खयं नाणं॥९॥
[प्रलयरवितेजःप्रकटमुत्पाटिमक्षयं ज्ञानम्॥]
padas.iast:
yena ghanakarmapaṭalaṃ prakaṭatapovahninā vinirdahya.
palayaraviteyapāyaḍamuppāḍiyamakkhayaṃ nāṇaṃ..9..
[pralayaravitejaḥprakaṭamutpāṭimakṣayaṃ jñānam..]
padas.iso:
yēna ghanakarmapaṭalaṁ prakaṭatapōvahninā vinirdahya.
palayaravitēyapāyaḍamuppāḍiyamakkhayaṁ nāṇaṁ..9..
[pralayaravitējaḥprakaṭamutpāṭimakṣayaṁ jñānam..]
padas.hk:
yena ghanakarmapaTalaM prakaTatapovahninA vinirdahya.
palayaraviteyapAyaDamuppADiyamakkhayaM nANaM..9..
[pralayaravitejaHprakaTamutpATimakSayaM jJAnam..]
padas.slp1:
yena GanakarmapawalaM prakawatapovahninA vinirdahya.
palayaraviteyapAyaqamuppAqiyamakKayaM nARaM..9..
[pralayaravitejaHprakawamutpAwimakzayaM jYAnam..]

padas.deva:
यश्च सुचिरं पृथिव्यां मिथ्यात्वान्धं विबोध्य भव्यजनम्।
ठाणं जम्मणजरमरणरोगपरिवज्जियं पत्तो॥१०॥
[स्थानं जन्मजरामरणरोगपरिवर्जितं प्राप्तः॥]
padas.iast:
yaśca suciraṃ pṛthivyāṃ mithyātvāndhaṃ vibodhya bhavyajanam.
ṭhāṇaṃ jammaṇajaramaraṇarogaparivajjiyaṃ patto..10..
[sthānaṃ janmajarāmaraṇarogaparivarjitaṃ prāptaḥ..]
padas.iso:
yaśca suciraṁ pr̥thivyāṁ mithyātvāndhaṁ vibōdhya bhavyajanam.
ṭhāṇaṁ jammaṇajaramaraṇarōgaparivajjiyaṁ pattō..10..
[sthānaṁ janmajarāmaraṇarōgaparivarjitaṁ prāptaḥ..]
padas.hk:
yazca suciraM pRthivyAM mithyAtvAndhaM vibodhya bhavyajanam.
ThANaM jammaNajaramaraNarogaparivajjiyaM patto..10..
[sthAnaM janmajarAmaraNarogaparivarjitaM prAptaH..]
padas.slp1:
yaSca suciraM pfTivyAM miTyAtvAnDaM viboDya Bavyajanam.
WARaM jammaRajaramaraRarogaparivajjiyaM patto..10..
[sTAnaM janmajarAmaraRarogaparivarjitaM prAptaH..]

padas.deva:
तं नमत नम्रशतमखमणिमुकुटविटङ्कघृष्टचरणयुगम्।
भुवणस्स वि बंधणपालणक्खमं वद्धमाणजिणं॥११॥
[भुवनस्याऽपि बन्धनपालनक्षमं वर्धमानजिनम्॥]
padas.iast:
taṃ namata namraśatamakhamaṇimukuṭaviṭaṅkaghṛṣṭacaraṇayugam.
bhuvaṇassa vi baṃdhaṇapālaṇakkhamaṃ vaddhamāṇajiṇaṃ..11..
[bhuvanasyā'pi bandhanapālanakṣamaṃ vardhamānajinam..]
padas.iso:
taṁ namata namraśatamakhamaṇimukuṭaviṭaṅkaghr̥ṣṭacaraṇayugam.
bhuvaṇassa vi baṁdhaṇapālaṇakkhamaṁ vaddhamāṇajiṇaṁ..11..
[bhuvanasyā’pi bandhanapālanakṣamaṁ vardhamānajinam..]
padas.hk:
taM namata namrazatamakhamaNimukuTaviTaGkaghRSTacaraNayugam.
bhuvaNassa vi baMdhaNapAlaNakkhamaM vaddhamANajiNaM..11..
[bhuvanasyA'pi bandhanapAlanakSamaM vardhamAnajinam..]
padas.slp1:
taM namata namraSatamaKamaRimukuwaviwaNkaGfzwacaraRayugam.
BuvaRassa vi baMDaRapAlaRakKamaM vadDamARajiRaM..11..
[BuvanasyA'pi banDanapAlanakzamaM varDamAnajinam..]
